New events land at the time you typed, and can be written in another time zone.

![OmaCal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omacal/v1.0.3/preview.png)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/88d5ff29-20e9-4e64-958d-b75dc3dade17

## Fixed

- **New events keep the time you typed.** An event added from OmaCal could land hours off: 18:30 to 20:00 typed in Berlin was saved as 20:30 to 22:00. hey-cli up to 1.7 sends no time zone on a machine without `$TZ` set, and HEY then reads the times as UTC. OmaCal now always sends the zone, so this works with every hey-cli from the 1.3.0 Omarchy ships. Events added with an earlier OmaCal keep their wrong time until you move them in HEY.

## New

- **A time zone for each event.** The new-event form has a zone field under the times. Left empty it is this machine's local time. Type a city (`new york`, `tokyo`) to write the times in that zone, as in HEY's own form; `↑` `↓` pick among the matches.

## Install

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omacal.git --enable
omarchy plugin disable omarchy.clock
```

Already installed: `omarchy plugin update crmne.omacal`.

OmaCal is an independent project, not created by, affiliated with, or supported by HEY or 37signals.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/crmne/omacal/compare/v1.0.2...v1.0.3
